summary: North kerb is lined with houses 1-8 m from the road edge.
reasons: No clear spot away from homes

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses front the whole north side, one only 1 m from the line and others 5-8 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow bending road, kerb against house frontages; the cars parked on the south side are across the road.
drivers.traffic: Quiet local street with a hatched bend at the west end.
drivers.convention: No signs; cars park on the south side, none on this north kerb.

flags: Dwellings within 10 m along the whole stretch
sun_shade: Mixed tree shade, houses and canopy on the north side.
